hooks.command: jq -r '"\(.message // "Claude needs attention") (\(.cwd // "unknown dir"))"' | { read -r msg; ~/.local/bin/claude-notify "🔔 $msg"; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '"Claude finished responding in \(.cwd // "unknown dir")"' | { read -r msg; ~/.local/bin/claude-notify "✅ $msg"; } 2>/dev/null || true
